name: paperos
description: PaperOS plugins for Claude: entity formation, transcript extraction, infrastructure deployment, and core workspace tools.

plugins.name: paperos-entity-setup
plugins.description: Form and manage PaperOS legal entities (LLC, C-Corp, LP, funds) in chat — the formation workflow + knowledge-base tools, with the skills that drive them.

plugins.name: paperos-deploy-mcp
plugins.description: Deploy and manage applications and standalone PostgreSQL databases on PaperOS infrastructure

plugins.name: paperos-transcript-extractor
plugins.description: Run PaperOS Entity Setup from your onboarding material — drop in a call transcript, notes, or documents and review extracted questionnaire answers in an embedded UI.

plugins.name: paperos-core-mcp
plugins.description: Work with PaperOS staging workspaces, reports, documents, signature status, investor records, and batch CSV uploads.
